$comment: The one-tap recovery button adds the EXACT host from the challenge. Matching loosely here would quietly widen every allow-list that button has ever touched, which is the trap the specification names for flow P3.

cases.name: fail · a host that is not on the list
boundary · a SUBDOMAIN of an allowed host is not allowed
cases.$why: api.exa.ai being allowed must not admit evil.api.exa.ai. Suffix matching is how an allow-list stops being one.

cases.name: boundary · the parent domain of an allowed host is not allowed
pass · a host match is case-insensitive, as hostnames are
pass · a wildcard admits any host, and flags the agent
boundary · the host is allowed but the RECIPIENT is not
cases.$why: Checking only the host is wrong. An allowed endpoint that starts asking for payment to a different address is exactly what a host-only check waves through.
